Class GrpcTranscodingConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.protobuf.json.transcoding.GrpcTranscodingConfiguration
@ConfigurationProperties("grpc.rest.transcoding") public class GrpcTranscodingConfiguration extends Object
Configuration of REST transcoding for gRPC methods that declare google.api.http rules.
